purpose: V2 historical research and execution-data source registry

required_contract.rule: Never synthesize 1-minute execution candles from 5-minute OHLCV. If real 1m history is absent, simulation must declare compatibility mode.

sources.name: DhanHQ Intraday Historical API
sources.coverage: 1, 5, 15, 25, 60 minute OHLCV; documentation states up to 5 years for active instruments and 90 days per poll window

sources.name: Upstox Historical Candle API V3
sources.coverage: minute history from January 2022; 1-15 minute requests have a one-month retrieval window
sources.role: secondary 1m execution-history adapter and India VIX/global-instrument support

sources.name: NSE Historical Index / India VIX
sources.coverage: official NSE historical India VIX data; use for benchmark/event research where historical resolution is available

sources.name: NSE Real-time 1 Minute / 5 Minute Snapshot
sources.coverage: official exchange 1-minute and 5-minute snapshot feed; commercial/SFTP product

sources.name: Indian Stock Market Minute Data (Hugging Face)
sources.coverage: large multi-year minute dataset; suitability and licensing must be verified before production use
sources.role: research-only external corpus when bytes are accessible

current_local_research_corpus.limitation: The locally accessible corpus used for this run does not contain usable 1m, NIFTY, India VIX, or sector-index intraday observations and uses the then-current LargeMidcap universe snapshot retrospectively.
